title: Decide note-retry liveness when a peer's claim lapses during the note's writer wait
outcome: Decide note-retry liveness when a peer's claim lapses during the note's writer wait
acceptance: The note's keyless retry identity and the observation write agree on whether the item's claim is live when the writer admits the note, or the docs state that a claim lapsing during the writer wait can make an identical resend a new note
A behaviour test covers a peer claim that lapses between a non-holder note's dispatch and its admitted write
